query:
SELECT DISTINCT empresaSlug, COUNT(*) as total_registros, 
  MIN(data) as primeiro_dia, MAX(data) as ultimo_dia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data LIKE '2026-03-%'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
